nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.stage4t_4dflow_t_segmentation¶

qvtpy stage 4t: per-timepoint local CD segmentation → seg_4dflow_4d.

Inputs

  • ComplexDifference_4D (requires stage-0 --compute-phase-derived), stage-3 centerlines.

Outputs

  • seg_4dflow_4d.nii.gz, per-timepoint segmentation_meta_t*.json, temporal_seg_summary.json.

nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.stage4t_4dflow_t_segmentation.dice_binary(mask_a: np.ndarray, mask_b: np.ndarray) → float | None¶

Dice coefficient for two boolean masks; None if both are empty.

The ratio is delegated to nvitk.measure.dice(); the only thing kept local is the temporal-QC convention that two empty masks score None (undefined) rather than 0.0.
